title: The sitemap advertised /discover/places/<city> for cities whose page canonicalises to /discover/cities/<city>

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, three independent finders: seo-metadata, seo-local, seo-urls). app/discover/places/[citySlug]/page.tsx points its canonical at /discover/cities/<slug> whenever the city also earns the density landing page, and app/sitemap.ts advertised the places URL regardless, so Search Console reads a submitted URL whose canonical is elsewhere. CLOSED 2026-10-05: placeRoutes drops any city in the density set, mirroring the page's rule; app/sitemap.test.ts pins it.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/sitemap.ts","utf8");if(!/\.filter\(\(c\) => !densitySlugs\.has\(c\.slug\)\)/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-656: the sitemap advertises /discover/places/<city> for a city whose page canonicalises to /discover/cities/<city>, so crawlers are sent to a URL that points elsewhere.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change (checked by stashing the fix); passes with it.
